districtFact: North East ISD publishes instructional calendar PDFs with first day of school, last day of school, student and staff holidays, student holidays and staff development days, early dismissal dates by school level, severe weather make-up days, grading period dates, school start and end times, and alternate calendars for ACE and Castle Hills Elementary.

about.title: About North East ISD
about.content: North East Independent School District serves students and families in the San Antonio area of Bexar County, within the San Antonio-New Braunfels metro area. The instructional calendar is a districtwide planning tool for families who need to track the first day of school, grading periods, student holidays, staff development days, early dismissal dates, severe weather make-up days, major breaks, and the last day of school. Because North East ISD also publishes alternate calendar resources for programs such as ACE and Castle Hills Elementary, families should use the calendar that matches their student's campus or program.

about.title: How to Use This North East ISD Calendar
about.content: Use this page for the district instructional calendar. Families should still check North East ISD for campus-specific events, testing windows, Castle Hills Elementary year-round program dates, ACE instructional calendar dates, athletics, graduation details, weather closures, and same-day announcements.

customSections.label: North East ISD Local Calendar Context
customSections.content: North East ISD calendar planning is especially local to northeast San Antonio and Bexar County families because the district publishes both a traditional instructional calendar and separate program calendars. Families comparing school-year plans should watch early dismissal schedules, ACE dates, Castle Hills Elementary dates, district testing windows, and severe weather make-up days before treating any calendar as final.

planningTips.title: North East ISD Calendar Usage Tips
content: Use the district instructional calendar for districtwide student dates, then verify campus-specific events through your school.
Check early dismissal dates by school level because elementary, traditional campuses, and high schools can have different early release dates.
Review Castle Hills Elementary and ACE calendars separately if your student follows one of those alternate schedules.
Use the PDF for official review and the ICS file for a one-time personal calendar import.

districtFaqs.q: Does North East ISD publish alternate calendars?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. North East ISD publishes alternate calendar resources such as the District Testing Calendar, ACE Instructional Calendar, and Castle Hills Elementary Calendar when applicable.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify North East ISD calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official North East ISD calendars page and campus announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with North East ISD.
